prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: polished PIXEL ART character design approval board for the existing original top-down 3/4 high fantasy browser RPG TAN NGUYET. This is an art review board, NOT a game screenshot.
Primary request: dramatically improve character identity and class silhouette compared with crude rectangle-overlaid small sprites, retaining charming beginner adventurers and coherent existing medieval green/slate/warm-gold world. Render a beautifully finished exact 4 ROW by 3 COLUMN design matrix, TWELVE complete full-body characters, generous separate cells. Large portrait-format board approximately 1536x2048. All figures are consistently top-down 3/4 sprites with visible crown/shoulders, NOT eye-level portraits, not isometric. Crisp hand-crafted pixel clusters, limited per-character palette, dark one-pixel native outlines, selective two-tone material highlights. Render each sprite as if 64x80 native pixels enlarged by nearest neighbor, not smooth illustration. Readable shapes survive reduction.
Columns exactly: CIVILIAN | SWORDSMAN | MAGE.
Rows exactly: HUMAN | ELF | DWARF | BEASTKIN.
Same individual identity across all three roles in a row.
Human: balanced ordinary proportions, dark tied-back hair, clearly exposed face, practical leather boots.
Elf: visibly long pointed ears OUTSIDE hair, slim taller silhouette, blond side-swept hair leaving ears readable, subtle leaf-shaped cloth seam (cultural decoration only).
Dwarf: genuinely short broad original body, powerful broad shoulders, large copper braided beard with one simple tie, squat sturdy boots; NEVER a squashed human sprite.
Beastkin: recognizable fox/wolf-like face with short distinct muzzle, upright furry ears, warm brown fur with cream muzzle/tail tip, visible bushy tail curved to side. Not a human with ears glued on, no extra limbs.
Civilian column: humble linen/olive tunic, cloth belt and small practical pouch, no armor or weapon, no glow.
Swordsman column: beginner one-hand steel sword with readable blade and modest warm gold guard; charcoal-teal cloth under shaped light steel shoulder/chest armor, leather belt/bracers and split tunic hem. Race features clearly visible. No cape covering face, no giant shield, no legendary spikes.
Mage column: beginner short wooden staff with small cyan crystal, slate-violet travel robe, articulated folds, wide sleeves, clear longer robe hem, modest pale gold rune clasp. Structurally different from swordsman armor; retain visible hair/ears/beard/tail. Tiny restrained cyan accents only, no permanent halo.
Top-left consistent light. Flat dark slate board background #17222a, subtle thin cell dividers, restrained ivory typography. Header exact text "TAN NGUYET / B2". Column and row labels exactly as specified, large legible. No other text. Each figure comfortably centered with space around all ears, tail, staff and feet; no overlap, no cropped weapons, no duplicated/missing grid cells. A consistent visual family yet all four races visibly distinct at thumbnail size.
Avoid: realistic/anime painting, 3D, smooth gradients, blur, antialiasing, muddy pixels, random noisy texture, excessive bloom, giant top-heavy heads, copied copyrighted characters, additional races/classes, archer/cleric, advanced gear, gore, watermark.
